faq_heading: Homes near Nicomekl Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Nicomekl Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Nicomekl Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Nicomekl Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Nicomekl Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Simonds Elementary (1.0 km south), U-Connect (1.0 km south) and H D Stafford Middle (1.1 km south-east).

Nicomekl Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 20050 53 Ave. It teaches grades K to 5.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Nicomekl Elementary.
How the Nicomekl Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Nicomekl Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Nicomekl Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Nicomekl Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 5 secondary, 2 other, 1 middle; 3 independent). The closest is Simonds Elementary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Murrayville Academy, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (1.4 km); the nearest independent school is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Belmont Elementary (2.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: Simonds Elementary (1.0 km south), Douglas Park Community (1.1 km east), Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary (1.2 km east), Alice Brown Elementary (1.6 km south), Uplands Elementary (2.0 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Simonds Elementary, 1.0 km south of Nicomekl Elementary.
